constraints.constraint: Authorization: Home campus admin, DAEP admin (level 1+), District admin only
RLS Policy: Restrictive - deny by default, explicit grants
Campus Isolation: Home campus admin sees ONLY their students
Pagination required on all report views (default 25, options 50/100)
Target load time: less than 2 seconds
Use existing createServerClient() pattern from lib/supabase/server
Use getTenantId() from lib/tenant for tenant resolution
Follow server action pattern: 'use server' directive, return { success, error? }
Use logAuditEvent() for all state-changing operations
Never hardcode colors - use CSS variables from theme
review_at_days field does not exist - display as null/TBD for now
school_year field does not exist - derive from start_date

tests.standards: Testing follows existing patterns in the codebase. Server actions should have unit tests for business logic. E2E tests use the established patterns for user workflows. Use Vitest for unit tests if available, otherwise follow existing test framework. Mock Supabase client for unit tests.
